Every value written PLACEHOLDER must be filled in once Karl's adoption calls are made (item 7 parts, item 8, C3c, the port); p5.py plan and p5-start.sh refuse to start while one is left.

arms._comment: pristine LDR 1.10.7 (run-ldr.sh LDR_PROFILE=baseline), as PLAN.md 10-18 'Phase 5 holdout ... on baseline and the final setup' and PHASE5-CHECKABLE-RULES.md item 3; runs folders <set>-baseline-p5

arms.name: final
arms.label: p5final
arms._comment: THE FINAL SETUP - PLACEHOLDER. items = a list from what bench2-queue.sh knows (setup critic verify2 tried notyet code fixes read claims); p4s7's list is in _items_example. An adopted item 7 part (paid search / S2), item 8 (merge) or a C3c model profile is NOT something the queue can switch today (bench2.py refuses LDR with the search fallback or S2 on; run/ldr.modelprofile is not checked) - such an item needs queue support first.

engine._comment: THE FINAL ENGINE - PLACEHOLDER. config = the Strata config both arms run on, as a strata-compare path (e.g. configs/P021m.json today, or the v0.2.7 port's config); sha12 = the first 12 hex digits of sha256 of that config's exe (P021m: 7b38796237f5). p5.py check-engine compares them with the server on 8080 (if up) and with the promoted config that strata-ensure.sh starts on demand (switch-model.sh's STRATA_CONFIG default).

_include_o01: o01 is not part of the holdout (o04-o06 are its open questions; o01 is in questions-screen.jsonl, FROZEN.txt). true = add o01 with the 8 GB wording as set p5-o01 (needs results/bench2/FROZEN-p5-o01.txt, staged as o01/; Karl's call).
_plan_order: most decisive first (Phase 5 is judged on the open reports, then the harder four; the 25 are the sanity line); within a block each set runs on the baseline, then on the final setup, so the two arms of a question are close in time
_open_ref_notes: optional one-line note per open question for its grader prompt, e.g. o05 if Qwen4 Flash was released after the reference (10-18) was written
